content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to understand how I can use the [product_name] app or the web server to modify the value of a network input while [product_name] is in run mode. I am working with [product_name] [version_no].

It is possible to switch network inputs using the web server, but it is not straightforward. On the web server, select "[product_name] Variable," then choose Add Variable, and under the "VM" option, you need to set the correct byte and bit combination from right to left.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in changing network input values on a [product_name] [version_no] while the system is running, using either the app or web server. The reply indicates this can be done via the web server by configuring variables, but the method involves manual bit settings, which could be complicated for those less familiar with the process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for a simple and direct method to adjust network input values through the app or web interface while the device is active.
